domains.domainPddl:
(define (domain ferry)
  (:requirements :typing)
  (:types
    location car ferry
  )
  (:predicates
    (at ?obj - (either car ferry) ?loc - location)
    (on ?c - car ?f - ferry)
    (empty ?f - ferry)
  )

  (:action board
    :parameters (?c - car ?f - ferry ?loc - location)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?c ?loc)
      (at ?f ?loc)
      (empty ?f)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?c ?loc))
      (not (empty ?f))
      (on ?c ?f)
    )
  )

  (:action debark
    :parameters (?c - car ?f - ferry ?loc - location)
    :precondition (and
      (on ?c ?f)
      (at ?f ?loc)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on ?c ?f))
      (empty ?f)
      (at ?c ?loc)
    )
  )

  (:action sail
    :parameters (?f - ferry ?from - location ?to - location)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?f ?from)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?f ?from))
      (at ?f ?to)
    )
  )
)

(define (domain miconic)
  (:requirements :typing)
  (:types
    passenger floor
  )
  (:predicates
    (origin ?p - passenger ?f - floor)
    (destin ?p - passenger ?f - floor)
    (above ?f1 - floor ?f2 - floor)
    (boarded ?p - passenger)
    (served ?p - passenger)
    (lift-at ?f - floor)
  )

  (:action board
    :parameters (?f - floor ?p - passenger)
    :precondition (and
      (lift-at ?f)
      (origin ?p ?f)
    )
    :effect (and
      (boarded ?p)
    )
  )

  (:action depart
    :parameters (?f - floor ?p - passenger)
    :precondition (and
      (lift-at ?f)
      (destin ?p ?f)
      (boarded ?p)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (boarded ?p))
      (served ?p)
    )
  )

  (:action up
    :parameters (?f1 - floor ?f2 - floor)
    :precondition (and
      (lift-at ?f1)
      (above ?f1 ?f2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (lift-at ?f2)
      (not (lift-at ?f1))
    )
  )

  (:action down
    :parameters (?f1 - floor ?f2 - floor)
    :precondition (and
      (lift-at ?f1)
      (above ?f2 ?f1)
    )
    :effect (and
      (lift-at ?f2)
      (not (lift-at ?f1))
    )
  )
)

(define (domain zenotravel)
  (:requirements :typing)
  (:types
    person city aircraft
  )
  (:predicates
    (at ?x - (either person aircraft) ?c - city)
    (in ?p - person ?a - aircraft)
  )

  (:action board
    :parameters (?p - person ?a - aircraft ?c - city)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?p ?c)
      (at ?a ?c)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?p ?c))
      (in ?p ?a)
    )
  )

  (:action debark
    :parameters (?p - person ?a - aircraft ?c - city)
    :precondition (and
      (in ?p ?a)
      (at ?a ?c)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (in ?p ?a))
      (at ?p ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action fly
    :parameters (?a - aircraft ?c1 - city ?c2 - city)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?a ?c1)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?a ?c1))
      (at ?a ?c2)
    )
  )
)
